title: Fill in Plural Nouns in Sentences

instruction.text: Choose the correct plural noun to complete the sentence.

atoms.sound: ssml: I brush my <break time='500ms'/> every night.
atoms.b: I brush my ((++teeth tooths)) every night.
atoms.finishSound: I brush my teeth every night.

atoms.sound: ssml: The <break time='500ms'/> were sharp enough to cut the meat.
atoms.b: The ((++knives knifes)) were sharp enough to cut the meat.
atoms.finishSound: The knives were sharp enough to cut the meat.

atoms.sound: ssml: We were dressed up as <break time='500ms'/> .
atoms.b: We were dressed up as ((++witches witchs)).
atoms.finishSound: We were dressed up as witches.

atoms.sound: ssml:  Can you help me wash the <break time='500ms'/> ?
atoms.b: Can you help me wash the ((++dishes dishs))?
atoms.finishSound: Can you help me wash the dishes?
